No Excuse Absentee Voting is an in-person absentee option for all voters during the two weeks before each election. No absentee voting excuse is necessary, and you do not need to apply for a ballot. You can cast your vote at any of the locations below. Call libraries to confirm hours of operations.

Polling Place Data

In North Carolina, voters have two options for voting in person:

  1. Voters may vote on Election Day at their designated polling place, determined by their residential address.
  2. Voters may vote early during the early voting period at any early voting site in their county.

On this page, you can find Election Day polling place data and early voting site data for current and past elections.
